newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian OTC market firmer in week to June 13.
newsitem.headline: Croatian OTC market firmer in week to June 13.

text.p: Croatian stocks trading on an over-the-counter market firmed last week ahead of the presidential election, the Varazdin market reported on Monday.
The leading seven-stock VIN index edged up 1.4 percent to 9,715 points as 15 traded issues rose, four fell and 10 were flat.
Volume was slightly higher at 14,598 units, and turnover also rose to 3.5 million kuna.
Food firm Belisce was the most active stock on volume of 4,260 shares, trading higher in a 51-66 kuna range. It closed at 65 kuna, up 14 percent, in Varazdin and 66 kuna at its outpost in Osijek.
Top gainer was Croatia Banka, adding 25 percent to 150 kuna but selling only 50 units.
Hotelier Imperijal from the island of Rab led decliners, falling 17 percent to 141 kuna with 50 units sold.
